tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description: The Hindu calendar day (pañcāṅga) for a date at a place: vāra (weekday), tithi (lunar day) and when it ends, pakṣa, nakṣatra and when it ends, sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset and the day's observances. Times are ISO-8601 in the place's time zone.

tools.name: get_daily_verse
tools.description: Vedha360's verse of the day — one scripture verse, the same for everyone on a given day — in Sanskrit, transliteration and a translation.

tools.name: search_scripture
tools.description: Search the Vedha360 library of Hindu scripture (Bhagavad Gītā, Upaniṣads, Purāṇas, Itihāsas and more). A verse reference such as 'BG 2.47' or 'Bhagavad Gita 2.47' is looked up exactly; any other text (a question or theme, e.g. 'duty without attachment to results') is semantic search. Results outside

tools.name: get_verse
tools.description: One scripture verse by its canonical reference (e.g. 'BG 2.47', 'BhP 10.14.1'): Sanskrit, IAST transliteration and a translation, with the work's source and licence.

tools.name: list_works
tools.description: The scripture works available (title, collection, verse count, completeness), each with its Sanskrit source and licence and whether it is readable in full ('full') or as a free preview ('preview').

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: Short stories from the scriptures (Vedha360 retellings): title, one-line lead, deity, cover image and credit. Use get_story for the full text.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One scripture story with its full retelling, cover-image credit and where the episode is in the Library.

tools.name: find_temple_towns
tools.description: Pilgrimage towns of India and Nepal (e.g. Tirupati, Varanasi, Kāñcīpuram): search by town or temple name, state or deity, or find towns near a point. Returns coordinates, main temple and a one-line highlight.

tools.name: get_temple_town
tools.description: One temple town: introduction, its temples (deity, significance), festivals, best time to visit, how to reach, related stories and yātrās, and sources.

tools.name: list_festivals
tools.description: Major Hindu festivals and vratas between two dates, with the deity, a one-line meaning and what to do. The calendar is curated; see `coverage` for the dates it covers.

tools.name: get_yatra_routes
tools.description: Yātrā (pilgrimage) routes through the sacred geography of the epics — Rāmāyaṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Śiva, Devī and more. Without route_id: every route; with route_id: that route's ordered stops (place, coordinates, scripture, note, linked stories).
